title: Second Minimum Time to Reach Destination
description: An undirected connected graph has nodes 1 through `n`. Traversing any edge takes `time` minutes. At every node, the traffic signal alternates between green and red in intervals of `change` minutes; you may leave only when it is green, and you cannot wait voluntarily during green. Return the second distinct arrival time from node 1 to node n.
constraints: edges form a connected simple graph
hints: Represent the graph with adjacency lists or a distance matrix appropriate to the limits.
Track shortest-distance states and respect all time or threshold rules.
